bounded_contexts.name: cloud-os
bounded_contexts.description: Talos-style node operating-system assets. First consolidation slice (G12 LANE-2) lands the foundational no_std crate set (core kernel, COSI resource model, resource kinds registry, readiness conditions, gRPC API message definitions) migrated from the preserved consolidate/kernel-snapshot-2026-06-08 branch (stack/operating-system).
